boundary: Detected true positives reproduce an exact allocator diagnostic in every vulnerable repetition with matched baseline and patched controls. Mitigated true positives causally block and report one matched exploit-enabling cross-identity reuse edge. No-signal rows are feature-matched negatives for the integrated witness only. These rows distinguish executed source witnesses from unrun candidates. They remain inconclusive until compiler critical-site identity coverage and a Type-Isolation-specific effect are validated. RSH-064 remains inconclusive until compiler coverage of the vulnerable Vec allocation, ownership transfer, and reclaim is validated and a controlled cross-identity replacement allocation is exercised. The derived pair validates allocator mechanism coverage; the pinned upstream Miri arm supplies source-vulnerability ground truth. The layout signal is policy-independent and is not attributed to TypeIso.
